progression.narrative: The performance opens on Dk4 and dwells most on F in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:41.6) introduces B, Ck, centred on Gk. The line peaks at Eb5 (598.6 Hz) at 4:02.0. It closes on the tonic (F4 → Gk3 → Gk4 → Gk4 → Gk4 → Gk4).
